page.overview:
Who is Bem?

Bem (born c. 1979–1980) who attended Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry from 1991 to 1998. He was Sorted into Gryffindor and was in Harry Potter's year.

Bem began his education at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in 1991, along with students Harry Potter, Hermione Granger and Ron Weasley. He was Sorted into the house of Gryffindor, but would not share a dormitory with the other known Gryffindor boys in his year.

Bem chose Care of Magical Creatures and Divination as electives in his third year. During a Divination class, Bem explained the meaning after Sybill Trelawney spotted a grim in his classmate Harry Potter's teacup. At some point, he went studying in the Great Hall as Seamus Finnigan told everyone that Sirius Black, the escaped prisoner of Azkaban, was sighted at an area close to Hogwarts. He agreed with Seamus that Black could get passed the Dementors guarding the prison and believed that he could do it again.

He was a black boy with dark eyes and a round face. He was also slightly overweight with a lisp.
